# The Purple Nest Hostel

> Safe, clean, and homely student hostel in Gwarko, Lalitpur (Kathmandu Valley), Nepal.

The Purple Nest Hostel provides premium student accommodation with modern facilities, hygienic meals, and a disciplined academic atmosphere for students, medical/engineering scholars, and exam aspirants.

- **Website**: https://thepurplenesthostel.com
- **Location**: Sinpa Marg, Gwarko, Lalitpur, Bagmati Province 44700, Nepal
- **Area / Hub**: Gwarko, Lalitpur, Kathmandu Valley (close to Gwarko Chowk, Ring Road, KMC Gwarko, NCIT Balkumari, Patan)
- **Exact Coordinates**: 27.668759882855277° N, 85.33061044536188° E
- **Google Maps**: https://www.google.com/maps?q=27.668759882855277,85.33061044536188
- **Phone**: +977 976-1158651
- **WhatsApp**: +977 976-1158651
- **Email**: stayatthepurplenest@gmail.com
- **Facebook**: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61589625489923
- **Visiting / Office Hours**: Every day, 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM
- **Main Gate Curfew**: 8:30 PM (Strict security policy)

## Key Facts & Inclusions

- **Monthly Fee Range**: NPR 11,000 – NPR 18,000 / month
- **Inclusions**: Monthly fee includes 4 freshly cooked meals a day, high-speed Wi-Fi, electricity, 24/7 solar and geyser hot water, inverter battery power backup, and automatic rooftop laundry.
- **Admission Fee**: NPR 5,000 (one-time) + refundable security deposit.
- **Diet**: 4 daily meals (Morning Tea & Breakfast, Lunch Dal Bhat, Afternoon Snacks/Tiffin, Dinner). Special non-veg chicken curry twice a week, Friday paneer, and Saturday Momo feast. Cooked with 5-stage RO purified water.
- **Security**: 24/7 CCTV surveillance across corridors, biometric fingerprint access, full-time resident warden, and night security guard.
- **Facilities**: Dedicated quiet study hall open until midnight, optical fibre Wi-Fi routers on every floor, solar hot water, rooftop sunny clothes drying terrace.
